name: Parallel Bar Leg Raise
steps: Support yourself on the parallel bars with straight arms and let your legs hang together.
Brace your abs tightly to prevent your torso from swinging.
Lift your legs forward as you curl your pelvis toward your ribs, stopping before you need to swing.
Lower your legs slowly back down to vertical without swinging.
tips: Push down strongly into the bars so your shoulders do not sink up toward your ears.
Bend your knees slightly if keeping your legs fully straight causes lower-back strain or heavy swinging.
